description: RayCraft Blazor is a component library for Blazor (.NET 10) with buttons, inputs, selection and date controls, forms, layout, navigation, data display, overlays, feedback, drag and drop, themes (light, dark and more) and English and Bulgarian texts. Works in Server, WebAssembly and Auto render modes. Free for use in your applications under the RayCraft End User License Agreement. More at https://raycraft.dev.
